description: Search GitHub PRs for remaining requirement titles
command:
cd /tmp && cat > search4.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
search() {
  slug="$1"; shift
  q="$1"
  n=$(curl -s --max-time 15 -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo:apache/echarts+type:pr+in:title+$q" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('\n'.join(str(i['number'])+' '+i['title'] for i in d.get('items',[])[:3]))" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "=== $slug =>"
  echo "$n"
  sleep 8
}
search matrix-dimension-length "matrix+dimension"
search toolbox-dataview-darkmode "dataView+dark"
search toolbox-emphasis-color "toolbox+emphasis+color"
search tooltip-listener-unbinding "tooltip+memory+leakage"
search typescript-esm-compatibility "export+assignment+esm"
search typescript-export-types "missing+missmatched+export+types"
search visualmap-darkmode-inrange "dark+mode+inRange"
search visualmap-unbounded-range "unboundedRange"
search vue-raw-instance "raw+Vue"
search release-merge-master "merge+release+master"
EOF
bash search4.sh
